name: Root Reconnaissance
description:
You tap into the dense root network of the land, using it to scout the area.

You gain a perfect mental map of the natural features of the surrounding lands in a 1-kilometer radius, so long as plant life grows there.

You can retain the mental map for 1 hour before it fades from your mind. Each extra success extends the duration by +1 hours.

You know the location of geographical features, such as rivers, forests, caves, mountains and so on.

You gain no knowledge of barren areas, such as factories or deserts, though you can tell which areas are barren and which are not.

Magical areas or disturbances appear as a blank void on your mental map, allowing you to know where they are but not the nature of the effect.
